newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end slightly ahead on mining stock buys.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end slightly ahead on mining stock buys.

text.p: The Lima stock exchange closed slightly higher Friday, as falls in some blue chips were outweighed by gains in the mining sector, brokers said.
The market would likely be broadly stable Monday, they added.
Friday, the General Index rose 0.29 percent to 1,713.78 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index climbed 0.32 percent to 2,477.35 points.
In a total of 2,204 trades, volume was a 46.5 million soles ($17.5 million), according to preliminary figures.
"The mining sector outperformed the market and could be heading for a technical correction," Victor Asto of local brokerage Finvest said.
The industrial sector, particularly in brewery stocks, is offering bargains at its current level, Asto added.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru edged up 0.32 percent to 6.32 soles in volume of 1.0 million shares.
Polymetal miner Morococha rose 3.40 percent to 2.74 soles on volume of 568,000 shares.
Backus y Johnston, the country's top brewery, fell 0.43 percent to 2.34 soles in volume of 288,000 shares.
